questions.question:

questions.solution:

• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other **given options**:
 
 
• **Fear- **to be worried or frightened that something bad might happen or might have happened. (चिंतित या भयभीत होना कि कुछ बुरा हो सकता है या हो सकता है।)
 
• **Joy- **great happiness. (महान खुशी।)
 
• **Anxiety- **an uncomfortable feeling of nervousness or worry about something that is happening or might happen in the future. (घबराहट की एक असहज भावना या जो कुछ हो रहा है या भविष्य में हो सकता है उसके बारे में चिंता करना।)
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that ‘penchant’ and ‘hatred’ are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.

• Antonyms: antipathy, disinclination, dislike, hate, hatred.

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I goes / to school / every day / irrespective of the weather.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is option 2) i.e. 'I goes.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'I goes'
 
• We can note that the subject of the sentence is** 'I'** which is a **first-person singular number.**
 
• Therefore we should not add 's/es' after the verb. 
 
• So the correct verb will be** 'go.'**
 
• In the given sentence we need to use 'go' instead of 'goes' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__ ***I go** to school every day irrespective of the weather.*

questions.question:
**Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options given.**

Fatima and Sana has both taken the vaccine.

options.text: Fatima and Sana was both taken the vaccine.
Fatima and Sana have both taken the vaccine.
Fatima and Sana were both taken the vaccine.
Fatima and Sana are both taken the vaccine.

questions.solution:
The correct sentence is option 2) i.e. 'Fatima and Sana have both taken the vaccine.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part ' has' in the given sentence.
 
• We can note that there are **two subjects 'Fatima' and 'Sana,' **and** **they are **connected by 'and'.**
 
• According to rules of grammar, **when two or more subjects are connected by 'and' **then the verb will be also in plural form.
 
• In the given sentence we need to **use 'have' instead of 'has'** to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Rahul **and** Amit **are** going to school.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__ *Fatima and Sana have both taken the vaccine.*

Correct sentence:__ *My boss keeps telling me all the time that money **doesn't grow on trees.***

questions.question:
**Sentence of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. These great leaders never escaped from their responsibilities and challenges because they knew greatness would come through great responsibilities. 

B. Leadership is one of the crucial elements in the field of management because most of the tie success or failure depends on the managerial skills of a leader.

C. There are not many leaders in the present world because, unlike ancient times, people are not ready to accept responsibilities.

D. Ancient India produced millions of people with leadership because it is an inner part of Indian culture to create leaders in every sphere of life. Chandragupta Mourya, Gandhi, Buddha, Bose etc. were leaders on this soil.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. "BCDA."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above mentioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• **Statement B** begins with the noun ‘Leadership’ and describes its purpose in relation to failure and success, it will be the first sentence.
 
• **Statement C** is an expletive sentence that begins with ‘There are' and it mentions that nowadays people lack leadership skills because they don't want to take responsibility.
 
• **Statement D** begins with the noun ‘ Ancient India’ and mentions that in Ancient India many people like Chandragupta Mourya, Gandhi, Buddha, and Bose emerged as powerful leaders and led the country.
 
• **Statement A** begins with the noun ‘These great leaders’ and describes that these leaders took responsibility and faced various challenges while changing the course of development of this country and eventually achieving greatness. So, it will be the last sentence.
 
• The correct arrangement is **BCDA.**

 

**The correct passage is**__: **(B)** *Leadership is one of the crucial elements in the field of management because most of the tie success or failure depends on the managerial skills of a leader.*** (C)** *There are not many leaders in the present world because, unlike ancient times, people are not ready to accept responsibilities.* **(D)** *Ancient India produced millions of people with leadership because it is an inner part of Indian culture to create leaders in every sphere of life. Chandragupta Mourya, Gandhi, Buddha, Bose etc. were leaders on this soil.* **(A)** *These great leaders never escaped from their responsibilities and challenges because they knew greatness would come through great responsibilities. *
